Afternoon Dive: Very refreshing and clean. I like this type of fragrance especially during hot weather.
Fresh aquatic type smell. Nothing complicated but very easy to use daily.
This one surprised me. The opening feels bright and energetic, then it becomes much softer after some time. For me this would be more of a daytime fragrance.
Nice fragrance, thoda light hai compared to what I normally use but smell bahut acchi hai.
Mast hai, fresh feel deta hai. Will recommend to others.
Al Wadi: Rich and elegant. Gives that Arabic luxury perfume feeling.
Very beautiful after it settles. Opening thodi strong lagi but baad me kaafi smooth ho jati hai.
Good one for evening. Not really something I would use everyday.
The fragrance has a warm, richer character. Dinner ya special occasion ke liye perfect lagega.
Alpha Blue: Fresh perfume hai and not too loud. Daily use ke liye accha hai.
I like that it smells fresh without being only aquatic. There is a little more depth once it dries down.
Nice smell but for me opening is better than dry down. Still good everyday perfume.
Aqua Wave: Bahut fresh hai. Perfect summer perfume.
Clean and watery. Simple but pleasant.
After shower use karne ke liye mast hai. Heavy bilkul nahi lagta.
Aventus: Fresh but still has some depth. Very versatile.
Good balance between fresh and slightly darker notes.
This type of fragrance works almost anywhere for me. Office, daytime, dinner—you don’t really have to think too much before wearing it.
I liked it more after 20-30 minutes. Starting thoda sharp laga mujhe.
Smells confident without being too loud.
Bahut sahi hai. Definitely wear again.
Azure Tide: Nice summer fragrance. Soft type of freshness.
Good smell hai but agar very strong perfume pasand hai toh thoda light lagega.
Bleu Voyage: Fresh and smooth. I like that it is not overly sweet.
This is probably the type of fragrance I would recommend when someone doesn’t know what style they want. Clean, modern and pretty safe.
Nothing too unusual but honestly that is why I liked it. Very wearable.
Blue OUD: I actually really like this. Darker than normal blue perfumes and has much more character once it settles.
Mere taste ke liye thoda zyada dark and woody hai. I was expecting something fresher because of the name. Oud lovers ko probably zyada pasand aayega.
BR 540: Sweet and airy without feeling too heavy.
Really elegant fragrance. One of my favourites from this style.
First few minutes I wasn't sure, but thodi der baad bahut smooth ho gaya.
Definitely noticeable. Sweet but not in a cheap sugary way.
Nice for occasions. Personally roz ke liye nahi use karungi.
Caramel OUD: Daytime ke liye thoda sweet hai but evening me mast lagega.
I expected only caramel sweetness but there is enough darker character behind it, which makes it much more interesting.
Cool Essence: Smell acchi hai, kuch bahut unique nahi but daily easily use kar sakte hai.
Cool Tide: Really clean and easy to wear.
Nice smell. Thoda aur depth hota toh better, but summer ke liye good hai.
Dark Rebel: This is exactly my type. Dark, masculine and much better for night than daytime.
Mere liye thoda zyada bold tha. Smell buri nahi hai but daily wear nahi karungi. Dark perfumes pasand hai toh you may like it.
Divine Essence: Feels very polished after it settles.
Occasion ke liye accha perfume hai. Too loud nahi hai.
Opening good hai but drydown mujhe aur accha laga. Classy feel hai.
Ember: Warm and slightly dark. Really nice.
Night time me better lagega. Afternoon me thoda warm feel hota hai.
Once it settles, it has a really comforting character. Not a fresh perfume, so depends what you like.
Eternal Elixir: Feels more suited for evenings and formal clothes.
Good fragrance hai but Mumbai ki garmi me daytime ke liye nahi.
I liked the deeper character of this one. It feels mature without smelling old fashioned.
Eternal Sauvage: I can wear this almost anywhere.
Probably one of the safest options if you like clean masculine fragrances. Doesn't require any special occasion.
Nice smell hai. Style thoda common hai but still very pleasant.
Eternal White: Office ke liye perfect type hai. Strong projection chahiye toh maybe dusra try karo.
Fire OUD: Very woody and warm. I enjoyed it but this is definitely not a blind choice for everyone.
Opening mujhe kaafi strong lagi honestly. Thodi der baad much better ho jata hai. Oud lovers ko definitely zyada pasand ayega.
Fresh Impact: Summer ke liye mast hai, daily use easy hai and headache type strong nahi.
Fume Vanille: Warm vanilla but with something darker behind it.
I usually find vanilla perfumes too sweet but this one has enough depth to balance it.
Night ke liye bahut accha. Afternoon me personally use nahi karunga.
The smoky side makes it feel more mature than a basic vanilla fragrance. Very comforting.
Golden Aura: Nice fragrance. Settle hone ke baad aur accha lagta hai.
Very smooth overall. I liked that it doesn't become overly sweet or heavy.
Golden Blush: Sweet hai but too much nahi.
I really enjoyed how smooth this feels after some time. Good for daytime as well as dinner.
Nice fragrance, bas thodi aur freshness hoti toh perfect.
Golden Flora: I am normally not into floral perfumes but ye expected se kaafi smooth tha.
Feminine without smelling too sweet. I can easily wear this during daytime.
Intense Suede: Daytime ke liye little heavy hai but night me really nice.
This style works really well with formal wear. Mature, dark and confident.
Intus: Nothing very loud which I actually prefer. Daily ke liye easy hai.
Invictus: Nice mixture of fresh and sweet.
This one feels younger and more casual to me. Perfect with jeans and T-shirt type days.
Good perfume. Mere expectation se thoda sweeter tha.
Luminous Veil: Subtle fragrance hai. Bahut loud perfume expect mat karna.
I actually prefer perfumes like this that stay graceful rather than trying to overpower everything around you.
Melior: Gift ke liye liya tha and fragrance pasand aaya.
Very feminine and pleasant without becoming overly sweet.
Fruity part accha hai. Mere taste ke liye thoda aur depth hota toh better.
Million: Opening thoda zyada sweet laga but baad me much better ho gaya.
Bold fragrance. Office se zyada evening ke liye choose karungi.
Most Wanted: Perfect evening perfume for my taste.
Sweetness thoda zyada hai compared to what I normally use, but smell is really nice.
This has that cozy evening type of smell. Really enjoyable once it settles.
Date night ke liye mast hai 👍
Mukhallat: Agar sirf fresh western perfume pasand hai toh maybe ye nahi. Arabic fragrance lovers ke liye bahut accha.
Noble: Loud nahi hai. More classy than attention seeking.
Ombre: Strong opening but very nice later.
I can understand why people love this style but personally leather perfumes mere liye nahi hai.
Very distinctive. Usual fresh perfumes jaisa bilkul nahi.
Pink Vanilla: Mere regular perfumes se thoda sweeter hai but drydown accha hai.
Vanilla is noticeable but still feels smooth and wearable.
Name dekh ke laga bahut childish sweet hoga, but actually settle hone ke baad quite elegant hai.
Pulse Royale: Nice smell overall, bas opening thodi aur strong hoti toh better.
Purple OUD: Good quality smell hai but mere taste ke liye honestly too heavy. Oud already pasand hai toh probably bahut accha lagega.
Qahwa: Pehle thoda unsure tha but 15-20 min baad warm character bahut accha aaya. Winter/evening type fragrance for me.
Symphoria: Easy to wear and not too strong.
Kuch bhi too sharp ya too sweet nahi lagta. Nicely balanced hai.
Tao Mist: Very soft perfume hai. Daytime ke liye good but strong perfume lovers ko light lagega.
Titanium: Opening sharp fresh type hai, baad me smoother hota hai. Drydown zyada pasand aaya.
Urban Icon: Office aur casual dono me easily chal jayega. Special occasion only type perfume nahi hai.
Vanaffe: Sweet hai but deeper notes ki wajah se boring nahi lagta.
Nice smell but mere liye too sweet. Meri sister ko mujhse zyada pasand aaya 😄
Vanilla Blossom: Mujhe laga bahut sugary vanilla hoga but actually kaafi smooth hai. Daily ke liye accha.
This is probably one of the easier vanilla perfumes for me because it doesn't feel too dense or heavy.
Really nice, bas opening little less sweet hoti toh perfect. After sometime its very good.
White OUD: Much easier to wear than heavier oud perfumes.
Nice balance of clean and woody.
Normally oud use nahi karta because sometimes too strong lagta hai. Ye comparatively clean aur easy laga, so I liked it.
